construction_notes.text: City of San Jose permit PD20-004 (Planned Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2020), status Approved, issue date 2026-07-08: "Planned Development Permit to allow construction of a new mixed use building (six stories) with 65 residential units and approximately 14,070 square feet of commercial use, including a Taiko performance building and an office, workshop, and gallery space," (city text cut off at 255 characters)

The ER22-112 addendum places the 65-unit building, plus a separate 1-story Taiko performance and storage building, on a 0.74-acre vacant area between the existing North and South buildings of the former Japantown corporation yard site, where 529 residential units and 3,500 sq ft of commercial space were already approved and built. The 2008 Final EIR covered up to 600 residential units on the 5.23-acre site. The project includes extended Saturday construction hours (8 a.m. to 5 p.m.) and removal of one ordinance-size tree.
